7.task: 7 Record a take and talk about it
notes: Recorded the way slice 5 offers it, from practice mode on the practice day. Chromium here has no microphone, so Close stands for Stop, and a take of the current song, created through the API before the walk, stands for the one Stop leaves in the list.
The "At <time>" checkbox that pins the comment to a moment is present but disabled until the audio plays; the stand-in take has no audio, so pinning cannot be done here.
The past practice page lists its takes.
